name: OPENXRD — Closed Book
protocol: OPENXRD published 217-item full set, closed-book mode, one option per question. AI-context and expert-context open-book results are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is exact option accuracy over the complete 217-question closed-book set.
explanation.zh: 分数是完整 217 道 closed-book 题目上的选项精确匹配率。

summary.en: OPENXRD evaluates expert X-ray diffraction and crystallography knowledge without external reference material.
summary.zh: OPENXRD 在不提供外部参考材料的条件下，评估 X 射线衍射与晶体学专业知识。

task_format.en: The model answers all 217 expert-reviewed XRD multiple-choice questions using only each question and its choices.
task_format.zh: 模型仅根据题目和选项回答全部 217 道经专家审核的 XRD 选择题。
